Package com.monkey.ultimatebot.sdk

Class UltimateBotClient

java.lang.Object
com.monkey.ultimatebot.sdk.UltimateBotClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class UltimateBotClient extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Java-only remote client for UltimateBot servers with remote API enabled.

This SDK is safe to use with implementation; it does not depend on Bukkit, Paper or the in-server api classes.
